items.name: NOAA exploration licence application under regulatory review
items.claim: Deep Sea Minerals has not obtained any subsea mineral exploration or commercial recovery rights; its NOAA exploration licence application remains subject to further regulatory, environmental and interagency review, public comment and potential legal challenge, and there is no assurance that an exploration licence will be issued within the Company's anticipated timeframe or at all.
items.source_excerpt: The Company has not obtained any subsea mineral exploration or commercial recovery rights. Its NOAA exploration licence application remains subject to further regulatory, environmental and interagency review, public comment and potential legal challenge, and there is no assurance that an exploration licence will be issued within the Company’s anticipated timeframe or at all.

items.name: Non-binding MOU with Impossible Metals for autonomous nodule-collection technology
items.claim: On July 6, 2026, Deep Sea Minerals entered into a non-binding memorandum of understanding with Impossible Metals Inc., a U.S.-based marine technology company developing autonomous underwater robotic systems for the selective collection of polymetallic nodules, establishing a framework for potential cooperation including technology evaluation, environmental monitoring, pilot testing and planning for potential future operations within the Company's prospective exploration licence areas, if and as such licences are awarded.
items.source_excerpt: On July 6, 2026, the Company entered into a non-binding memorandum of understanding with Impossible Metals Inc., a U.S.-based marine technology company developing autonomous underwater robotic systems for the selective collection of polymetallic nodules. The memorandum establishes a framework for potential cooperation in connection with the evaluation and possible deployment of such technology within prospective exploration licence areas of the Company, if and as such licences are awarded. The contemplated areas of cooperation include technology evaluation, environmental monitoring, pilot testing and planning for potential future operations. The memorandum does not obligate either party to enter into a definitive agreement or proceed with commercial deployment.

notes: Stored evidence is Deep Sea Minerals' MD&A exhibit (6-K, filed 2026-08-14). It confirms the Company has a pending NOAA exploration licence application (PROJECT, no licence yet issued) and a non-binding MOU with Impossible Metals for autonomous nodule-collection technology (CONTRACT-stage cooperation, not a definitive agreement). The Company's legacy Twilite Gold Project (Newfoundland) was excluded: the same document discloses it is being divested with its carrying value impaired to $nil, so it no longer reflects a live pipeline exposure. No dollar-denominated backlog or RPO figure was found in the stored document.
